reward: Complete H100 canonical global-risk trajectory labels; time-zero and short windows retained separately, not substituted.
data: Sealed original joint corpus plus actual round1 learned-policy own-history corpus. Strictly verified initialization only. FIT6, historical INNER0002; no outer0001 fit/selection, no fresh confirmation or VAL/TEST.
GLOBAL_RISK_components: Three-class benefit/harm/neutral, global value, target-only value, explicit other-person future-harm logit, explicit target N10 future-harm logit. Runtime harmful=max(class harm, other-person harm, target harm). Current association cost is the exact solver's observed raw feature, not GT or a fabricated future value.
comparable_inputs: Exactly frozen32 current action and previous3 causal proposal vectors. FIT sequence-equal normalization and loss; no additional images/candidates/backbone.
selection: Earliest minimum historical INNER objective epoch. Retain every epoch and checkpoint. Reuse frozen18-point benefit/harm/value calibration grid; empirical<=2% harm with>=5 accepted and nonzero benefit. No legal point is CALIBRATION_ABSTAIN, not PASS.
H100_noop_warning: Actual new-policy replay required even for calibrated heads; training loss, static selection, and zero interventions do not prove full MOT success.
next_actual_round: Freeze all fitted checkpoints before multi-person full joint replay and, if useful, the second actual on-policy rollout/relabel round. Max2 on-policy collection rounds, no automatic next stage.
